channel.title: Leading Quietly
channel.description: A daily two-host leadership coaching podcast for analytical, quiet, process-driven leaders: speaking early, running the room, leading specialists, holding your line calmly, and scaling beyond yourself.

item.title: Day 3: Opening With the Decision You Need (Role-Play)
item.description: Quiet Is a Way to Lead — Opening With the Decision You Need (Role-Play). Today's rep: Write the exact opening sentence for your next meeting before you walk in and speak within the first five minutes.

item.title: Day 2: Being Chosen vs. Leading Well: What the Research Actually Shows
item.description: Quiet Is a Way to Lead — Being Chosen vs. Leading Well: What the Research Actually Shows. Today's rep: Before your next meeting, write one sentence at the top of your notes naming the single decision the group needs to reach.

item.title: Day 1: Prepared, Clear, and Steady: Leading Without Changing Who You Are
item.description: Quiet Is a Way to Lead — Prepared, Clear, and Steady: Leading Without Changing Who You Are. Today's rep: Write your own one-line leadership statement and say it out loud twice before tomorrow's first meeting.
